response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_item_ratio, AVG(1.0 * line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count FROM per_item

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is skipped.
